source_identity_rule: source_timestep_file + repeat_from_filename; inner run_id is retained only as descriptive metadata because it repeats across some files
profile_alignment: time relative to brake command; synthetic t=0 sample from measured initial speed and zero displacement; linear interpolation onto 0.01 s grid; last measured displacement held constant after the recorded profile end
profile_meaning: mean speed and displacement profile at each calibrated starting speed; these profiles are built for subsequent multi-speed use and are not currently selected by the retained v1.2.1 pilot executor

holdout_validation.method: Leave-one-speed-out linear interpolation in measured initial speed between adjacent calibrated mean profiles
holdout_validation.maximum_single_vehicle_error_scope_s: 0 to the end of the longer adjacent profile; maximum horizon 1.42 s
holdout_validation.bound_definition: |e_gap| <= |e_lead_displacement| + |e_ego_displacement|; both terms are bounded by the maximum held-out single-vehicle displacement error
holdout_validation.acceptance: Accept only when the validation bound is <= the configured allowance; otherwise Gate must use INVALID fail-safe braking
holdout_validation.interpretation: Preliminary engineering screening bound from two internal held-out speeds; not a statistical confidence bound and not evidence of extrapolation accuracy
